name: Detroit Lions
notes: Revenue, operating income and value are Forbes estimates for the 2025 season (list of 9 Sep 2026, via Wayback). The only archived Forbes team profile is the 2025 edition (value $5.4B, 2024 season): stadium owner, capacity, player expenses ($384M, 2024 season) and championships come from it; it also gives Year Purchased 1964, Price Paid $4.5M. Founded: the Portsmouth Spartans joined the NFL in 1930 and moved to Detroit in 1934 (Hall of Fame). The front office lists Rich Haddad as President and CEO with Rod Wood as outgoing. Family members' stakes are not stated. No ownership transaction or institutional stake since 2015 found. Legal entity, attendance, social counts not found.

ownership_summary: Owned by the Ford family (William Clay Ford family, owners since 1964 per Forbes). Sheila Ford Hamp succeeded her mother Martha Firestone Ford as principal owner and chair in June 2020; Martha Ford Morse, William Clay Ford Jr. and Elizabeth Ford Kontulis are owners/vice chairs. No institutional holder found.
